summary: Meridian Corp filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 results via a press release and earnings supplement (Items 2.02 and 7.01). The board also declared a $0.14/share quarterly cash dividend payable May 11, 2026 to holders of record May 4, 2026 (Item 8.01). No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine earnings and dividend announcement. No deal terms are present.
